document: JPL 810-005 module 105, Revision E, issued 2015-10-22, section 2.1.5, pages 14–15
scope: Published climatological arithmetic example for DSS-34 at Canberra, Ka 32 GHz. Not DSS-43 hardware and not a forecast for any selected stay.
comparison: The published noise calculation uses the rounded intermediate loss factor 1.295. Unrounded direct evaluation differs slightly. Tolerance 0.06 K tests the printed arithmetic, not physical uncertainty.
